title: Restorin® NR is a Highly Efficient NAD+ Precursor.
intervention: Restorin NR (proprietary crystalline form of NR fumarate)
design: preclinical animal study (3-arm comparison of NAD+ precursors in aged mice)

outcomes.name: circulating NAD+ levels
outcomes.effect_text: at 1 mmol/kg/day, Restorin NR yielded significantly higher circulating NAD+ levels than either comparison treatment

outcomes.name: blood NAD+ elevation (low dose)
outcomes.effect_text: 0.33 mmol/kg/day induced blood NAD+ elevation statistically equivalent to 1 mmol/kg/day NR chloride or NMN (n=11)
